comment: SkyBlock event rules. Days are 1-based: day of the year for 'starts' (Early Spring 1st = 1, Late Winter 31st = 372), day of the month for 'monthDays'. Minutes are SkyBlock minutes (1440 a day). certainty: CONFIRMED = pinned from the tab widget against the sidebar date in the maintainer's logs; WIKI = from the wiki, unchecked. An event with no rule is shown only while the tab widget names it.

events.name: Hoppity's Hunt
events.note: Early Spring 1st to the end of Late Spring (93 days): the end measured, Spring-only from HoppityChat.

events.name: Season of Jerry
events.note: Starts Late Winter 24th: 115 minute-resolution readings. The 3-day length is WIKI.

events.note: Days 7, 14, 21 and 28 of every month, 00:00-06:00 SkyBlock time.
